Our [b]new trailer[/b] revealing the release date has just been released on IGN’s GameTrailers channel![/p][p][/p][p]On [b]November 14th[/b], a very important mission awaits you:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="U8VPgs6GQl8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Don’t go off the rails, we’ve got news!
notes.notes:
Soon we’ll have a release date for you along with an exclusive trailer! For now, enjoy a small glimpse of the chapter that will take place on a train in Russia!

Object teleportation! Manipulate objects and place them in more advantageous spots for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/04c61ee23b5db34618d13b5240f34edd11248250.gif[/img]

These guys are called janitors for a reason, they clean up the mess caused by teleporters, including your teleportation gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/888ac6eb3b08636e0b50dcebf27a7680c150cae4.gif[/img]

This object needs extra attention, it makes noise! Use them to lure android and human guards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/6d12102b41529a94a6db3405ce506d35ac35344b.gif[/img]

We’re reaching the final stretch of development and will reveal more about the game and its story soon, along with the release date. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo update! Hookshot unlocked!
notes.notes:
We are participating in two events at the same time! lol
That's right, we are part of the "Days of Ramadan Festival" AND the "Made in Brazil Sale"!

Also, we have a new version of the demo, the hookshot has been unlocked! This gadget allows the player to move quickly across objects, opening up new gameplay possibilities and new ways to get through the levels!

For now, that's it! Follow us for more updates (which we will definitely have) and have fun!

notes.title: Welcome to the Jungle!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We hope you're all doing well! We've been quite busy over the last few months working on our final demo (which will likely be available on Steam in January 2025) and the chapter set in Brazil!

Here's a sneak peek of what awaits you in the jungle:

[b]Watch your step down there![/b] How about using a zipline to make a stylish entrance?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/6ffb7c859b3e4897070ca5984259d7842d85c982.gif[/img]

[b]Help! Somebody help me![/b] Rescue the hostages captured by the jungle terrorists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/0c20e7cb3288fe1bee357bab511452071a662112.gif[/img]

[b]Ouch, that hurts![/b] Use traps to get past the human guards. They’re smarter than the old metal cans you usually face, but their vision isn’t as sharp!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/f4a46a6190d55f8951ea459df947a6da1e80a6e6.gif[/img]

[b]Grrrr![/b] This object has a very convenient ability. Scare nearby human guards and make them tremble with fear! (Note: Don’t try it with robots; they’re... well, robots, you know?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/5c2f40e72805518baa8e1349839623c2f47b891c.gif[/img]

[b]I am speed![/b] Want to move faster? Starting in chapters 2/3, you’ll unlock this handy gadget to help you reach your objectives more quickly. Don’t worry, it’s quiet enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180701/12ccb46460bde8b026ed23c2caeceeff5ccd3c0e.gif[/img]

Stay tuned! We’ll have more news about the demo very soon. Stay safe, and happy holidays!

notes.title: We have some news!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, how's it going? We've got some exciting news for you, so stay tuned!

First off, we’re thrilled to announce that we are now working on the chapter that will take place in Brazil! This chapter is going to introduce a lot of new things that we can't wait to share, and there are already some spoilers about these features on our page!

Soon, we’ll also be releasing a small preview of the cutscenes that will tell a big part of the game’s story!

And in case you haven’t noticed yet, the gameplay trailer is now live on Steam! You can now see our beloved Siren in action!

Want to be the first to hear all the latest updates on our game? Follow our creator page and the game itself; there’s a lot of good stuff coming your way! Thanks so much for all the support, and see you next time!
